verification.notes: The source context quotes the complaint parenthetical that Harpole did not coordinate with Charis Bible College or the Woodland Park Police Department because he was not advised of the planned Kirk visit. The federal docket independently confirms Harpole filed the complaint, while the public episode transcript preserves the quoted wording. The complaint document itself was not available without restricted docket access, limiting confidence to medium.
